description: This file implements a retry mechanism for subscription notification messages in a C-based system, managing message retries, timing, and cleanup for subscription notifications in a device management context.

classes.name: subs_retry_t
classes.description: Structure representing a subscription notification message to retry, including message details, retry timing, and state.

classes.name: subs_retry_vector_t
classes.description: Structure holding an array of subs_retry_t entries for managing multiple retries.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Init
methods.description: Initializes the retry vector and sets up the timer for retry execution.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Stop
methods.description: Frees all allocated memory and cleans up the retry list.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Add
methods.description: Adds a new subscription notification message to the retry list, or replaces an existing one.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific message from the retry list upon receiving a response.

methods.name: SUBS_RETRY_Delete
methods.description: Deletes all retry entries associated with a specific subscription instance.

methods.name: SubsRetryExec
methods.description: Executes retries for messages whose retry time has arrived, and manages retry timing.

methods.name: FindRetryEntry
methods.description: Finds a retry entry matching a given subscription instance and differentiator.

methods.name: CalcNextSubsRetryTime
methods.description: Calculates the next retry time based on retry count and parameters.

methods.name: UpdateFirstRetryTime
methods.description: Updates the earliest retry time and reloads the timer accordingly.

methods.name: DestroySubsRetryEntry
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a retry entry and marks it for deletion.

methods.name: GarbageCollectSubsRetry
methods.description: Removes all entries marked for deletion from the retry list.
